improvement.name: Playwright 1.63.0-alpha-2026-08-20 qualification
improvement.problem: Ferrum's verified toolchain remained on the Aug-17 Playwright 1.63 alpha while a newer Aug-20 next build was available; Opera GX required a narrow screenshot compatibility path under the newer runtime.
implementation: Advance Playwright and playwright-core to exact 1.63.0-alpha-2026-08-20 through the authoritative npm lock.
Inject PLAYWRIGHT_LEGACY_SCREENSHOT=1 only for the Opera GX browser-matrix worker when the caller has not explicitly configured it.
Retain immutable GitHub Action SHA pins, frozen npm installs, all browser/app targets, evidence, restart, packaging, mobile, WebDriver and Tauri coverage.
Remove the verification-in-progress Stack candidate marker only after exact-head qualification and merge.
acceptance: Authoritative lock resolves Playwright and playwright-core exactly to 1.63.0-alpha-2026-08-20.
Ferrum CI remains fully green across Linux/Windows browser, MV3, Workbench, Electron, desktop package/provenance, Selenium Grid, Brave, Opera GX, Lightpanda and Android/Appium.
Native Windows, Tauri WebDriver, service fixture, stateful API and network-fault companion workflows pass on the exact proposal head.
Merged product tree is byte-identical to the exact tested proposal tree.

coverage: unit tests, syntax, shell checks, MCP surface and independent MCP Inspector, evidence integrity
independent Brave and Opera GX, real Selenium Grid WebDriver, Lightpanda and real Android/Appium
real embedded and official-reference Tauri WebDriver paths on Linux and Windows

risk.summary: Playwright remains a prerelease forward line and the Opera GX compatibility environment variable is intentionally browser-specific.
risk.rollback: Revert the coherent Playwright manifest/lock and Opera-only compatibility changes to the prior verified Aug-17 toolchain if a later exact runtime regression cannot be fixed forward.
